title: The Octopus Who Escaped
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์/ข่าว
lines: Octopuses are famous for being clever, but one octopus in New Zealand
surprised even the scientists who studied **it**. Inky, as the aquarium staff
called him, had lived there for two years. One night, a worker forgot to
close the top of his tank completely. Inky climbed out, crossed the floor
and squeezed into a narrow pipe that led to the ocean. In the morning, **he**
was gone. Only a wet trail on the floor showed where he had traveled.
Octopuses have no bones, so they can fit through any hole bigger than
**their** beak, the only hard part of their body. They also have about 500
million nerve cells, two-thirds of **which** are in their arms. This means
each arm can "think" and act partly on its own.
The aquarium staff were not angry. "He was a curious fellow," the manager
said. "**That** is exactly why visitors loved him." The pipe has now been
covered, but **many** still visit the tank and hope to see a new Inky.
